films.title: Slapface
films.overview: A boy deals with the loss of his mother by creating a relationship with a dangerous monster.

films.title: The Mortuary Assistant
films.overview: Rebecca Owens, a recent mortuary science graduate takes a night shift job at River Fields Mortuary. Initially, the job seems straightforward — embalming bodies, completing paperwork, and keeping things tidy. But once Rebecca starts working the night shift, things take a dark turn.
